name: Commerce National Bank of Greece (Redirect)
description: Off-site redirect payment gateway that integrates the National Bank of Greece (NBG) with Drupal Commerce via the GlobalPayments Hosted Payment Page (GP-API PHP SDK). Shoppers are redirected to GlobalPayments' hosted card page to pay; a signed callback (SHA-512 over the payload keyed with the merchant app key) records the Commerce payment. Supports major credit cards, Google Pay/Apple Pay, 3-D Secure, and test/live modes.
project_description:
Drupal Commerce Payment Gateway Plugin for National Bank of Greece (NBG). Customers are redirected to the GlobalPayments Hosted Payment Page to complete their transaction, then returned to your site once payment is confirmed.

 Features 
 
 Offsite redirect payment flow 
 Credit card support 
 Digital wallet support (Google Pay and Apple Pay). Requires testing/activation with your merchant account 
 3D Secure authentication 
 Test and Live modes

 Post-Installation 
 
 Go to /admin/commerce/config/payment-gateways 
 Click Add payment gateway 
 Choose National Bank of Greece (Redirect) as the plugin
